usage: A creamy fruit commonly used in salads, toast, and Western-style dishes
Often eaten fresh or mashed rather than cooked
More commonly found in supermarkets than traditional wet markets
Frequently associated with texture and ripeness rather than sweetness
Used in both casual speech and food-related conversations
